name: Flexon-9M
description: Flexon-9M is a woven single-wall CNT mesh produced by Tessera Materials, engineered specifically for conformal body armor and protective underlayers. The weave geometry uses a non-repeating quasi-crystalline pattern that defeats crack propagation — when a projectile or blade strikes, energy disperses radially through the mesh rather than concentrating at impact. Unlike rigid armor, Flexon-9M drapes and moves with the body, remaining functional at full flex, and can be layered to scale protection without sacrificing mobility.
story_hooks: Flexon-9M is common enough that mid-tier enforcers wear it under street clothes — a fixer needs to know what ammunition actually defeats it before sending someone into a confrontation.
Veilweave Textiles produces a luxury fashion line using Flexon-9M weave that doubles as functional armor — the Spire elite wear protection no one suspects is there.
A Shelf-level street medic has a single Flexon-9M vest they've repaired a dozen times; the mesh is degrading in ways they can't measure and they need to know if it still works.
